name_i18n.ja: アポストル群島の氷洞

description_i18n.zh-TW: 僅當蘇必略湖冰層足厚，NPS 才開放冰洞路線（通常1–3月，年度公佈）——季節窗追蹤官方案件而非保證；冰簾/冰錐洞穴景觀；與既有 us 五大湖點（尼加拉瀑布）題材錯位——本點為湖冰洞。
description_i18n.en: The ice-cave route opens only when Lake Superior ice is thick enough (typically Jan-Mar, dates yearly announced by NPS) - the window tracks the official opening, never a guarantee; disjoint from the Niagara subject.
description_i18n.ja: スペリオル湖の氷が十分に厚い時のみNPSが氷洞路線を開放（例年1〜3月、年度公表）。氷瀑の洞窟景観。ナイアガラとは題材が別。

geometry.derivation_method: CL-DATA-53 admission web verification 2026-11-09 (NPS Apostle Islands（Meyers Beach 冰洞路線，蘇必略湖面約183 m；座標 medium（岸線對位））; source URLs: https://www.nps.gov/apis/learn/nature/ice-caves.htm). CL-DATA-23 dossier coordinate was approx - corrected/confirmed as stated.

access_notes_i18n.zh-TW: 僅當蘇必略湖冰層足厚，NPS 才開放冰洞路線（通常1–3月，年度公佈）——季節窗追蹤官方案件而非保證；冰簾/冰錐洞穴景觀；與既有 us 五大湖點（尼加拉瀑布）題材錯位——本點為湖冰洞。（開放/營運狀態以現場公告為準。）
access_notes_i18n.en: The ice-cave route opens only when Lake Superior ice is thick enough (typically Jan-Mar, dates yearly announced by NPS) - the window tracks the official opening, never a guarantee; disjoint from the Niagara subject. (Opening/operating status follows on-site notices.)
access_notes_i18n.ja: スペリオル湖の氷が十分に厚い時のみNPSが氷洞路線を開放（例年1〜3月、年度公表）。氷瀑の洞窟景観。ナイアガラとは題材が別。（開放・営業状況は現地の案内に従う。）

safety_notes_i18n.zh-TW: 請依現場安全指示行動；夜間/冬季天候險惡時請勿冒進。
safety_notes_i18n.en: Follow on-site safety guidance; do not push on in severe night/winter weather.
safety_notes_i18n.ja: 現地の安全指示に従う。夜間・冬季の悪天候では無理をしない。

name_i18n.ja: アポストル群島の氷洞

geometry.derivation_method: CL-DATA-53 admission web verification 2026-11-09 (NPS Apostle Islands（Meyers Beach 冰洞路線，蘇必略湖面約183 m；座標 medium（岸線對位））; source URLs: https://www.nps.gov/apis/learn/nature/ice-caves.htm). CL-DATA-23 dossier coordinate was approx - corrected/confirmed as stated.

observation_relations.uncertainty_note: CL-DATA-25 admission reference; angles and distance unknown pending field survey.

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 季節窗判定（window_open/window_closed，例年窗 01-01–03-15 讀自 seasonal-calendar.json，實況優先，兩者皆缺時誠實 not_evaluatable）：本題材受營運期/季節窗硬性約束（CL-DATA-25 建置時即帶窗）。
rationale_i18n.en: Seasonal-window verdict (window_open/window_closed; typical window 01-01-03-15 from seasonal-calendar.json, observed takes precedence, neither present = honestly not_evaluatable): this subject is hard-gated by an operating/season window (built in at CL-DATA-25 admission).
rationale_i18n.ja: 季節窓判定（window_open/window_closed。例年窓 01-01〜03-15 は seasonal-calendar.json から、実況優先、両方欠ければ誠実に not_evaluatable）。本題材は営業期・季節窓でハード制約（CL-DATA-25 作成時に組み込み）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 能見度 ≥3 km：樹氷拍攝的否決條件是暴雪/白牆（ホワイトアウト）；降雪本身不否決（飄雪中的樹氷反而是加分）。
rationale_i18n.en: Visibility >= 3 km: the veto condition is blizzard/whiteout; falling snow itself is not a veto (snow monsters in falling snow are a bonus).
rationale_i18n.ja: 視程≥3km。否決条件は吹雪・ホワイトアウト。降雪自体は否決しない（降雪中の樹氷はむしろ好条件）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 風 <15 m/s：山頂強風下拍攝與纜車/步行安全界線（八甲田公式 25 m/s 運休的保守折半值；安全為先，成立值可再校準）。
rationale_i18n.en: Wind < 15 m/s: summit-wind safety boundary between shooting and ropeway/walking risk (a conservative half of Hakkoda's official 25 m/s suspension threshold; calibrated down for safety first).
rationale_i18n.ja: 風<15m/s。山頂の強風での撮影とロープウェイ・歩行の安全境界（八甲田公式25m/s運休基準の保守的半分。安全優先で較正）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 時間窗（必要條件）：日間樹氷只在民用光（太陽仰角 > −6°）內成立
rationale_i18n.en: Time window (necessary condition): daytime juhyo qualifies only in civil light (sun elevation > -6 deg)
rationale_i18n.ja: 時間窓（必要条件）。日中の樹氷は市民光（太陽高度>−6°）内でのみ成立

evidence_claims.scope_note: CL-DATA-53 admission (PM-judgment GROWTH-ONLY 2026-11-09, 5km dedupe, owner Gemini US list); coordinates/elevation web-verified 2026-11-09 (sources in camera derivation_method and data/v2/audits/cl-data-53_web_evidence.json); thresholds provisional pending real-shoot calibration.
